item.title: Sun Yat-sen University's GeoThinker-F Speeds Up Spatial Reasoning 3.6x by Dropping the 3D Encoder
item.description: Sun Yat-sen University's GeoThinker-F learns 3D cues from VGGT during training, then drops it, cutting spatial reasoning latency from 1.45 s to 0.40 s.

item.title: Future Doctor Says MedGPT Outscored Doctors in 88% of Comparisons on Complex Lung Cancer Cases
item.description: Future Doctor says MedGPT beat unassisted doctors in 660 of 750 comparisons on 40 complex lung cancer cases, scored by AI judges. The figures are self-reported.

item.title: Qianfan Constellation Reaches 274 Satellites, 50 Short of SpaceSail's Year-End Service Target
item.description: Qianfan has 274 satellites in orbit, 50 short of the 324 SpaceSail needs to start service by year-end. A user terminal is certified in Brazil, its likely first market.
